sharedStructure: Each problem has a proposed action whose apparent utility is uninterpretable unless the admissible domain, physical or informational resource, measurement capability, and protected outcome are fixed first. The same ordered rule applies: type the input, reject the earliest violated precondition, and prevent a software pass from granting a stronger physical or scientific claim.

variableMapping.unit: battery specimen and its frozen manufacturing domain
variableMapping.resourceOrNuisance: chamber, fixture, channel, wave, RPT burden
variableMapping.adjudicand: pre-outcome cohort admission and later Harrell C
variableMapping.firstUsefulRefusal: missing chemistry-build-protocol domain or unidentifiable LIFE margin

variableMapping.unit: physical asset and its twin state

variableMapping.firstUsefulRefusal: uncommitted domain, stale resource state, or outcome-contaminated update

variableMapping.resourceOrNuisance: stress protocol, chamber, diagnostics, extrapolation domain
variableMapping.adjudicand: whether accelerated evidence may enter an extrapolation claim
variableMapping.firstUsefulRefusal: empty U95 < M <= min(S,H) interval or absent safety envelope

variableMapping.unit: candidate experiment proposed by an autonomous laboratory
variableMapping.resourceOrNuisance: instrument availability, calibration, safety authority, information access

variableMapping.adjudicand: admit, refuse, or send the proposal to independent authorization
variableMapping.firstUsefulRefusal: earliest failed prerequisite returned as an observable action outcome

conditionsForTransfer: The gate order is frozen before protected outcomes are available.
Each gate has an observable pass condition and a repair action.
A later gate cannot waive an earlier failure.
The final capability is weaker than physical execution or scientific confirmation.
Independent implementations receive the same finite input language.
breakConditions: Gate order is changed after seeing which condition fails.
A schema pass is treated as truth of physical records.
Owner references are treated as authenticated signatures without verification.
A synthetic pass is promoted to laboratory readiness.
The autonomous planner can read protected outcomes while choosing the admission rule.
minimumValidation: Reconstruct the same bundle in independent implementations, inject one fault per gate and at least one multi-fault case, require exact first-failure and receipt-hash agreement, then present a real outcome-blind laboratory bundle to an independent safety and domain owner.
rc60Result: Node and Python agree on 18 of 18 receipts. Seventeen cases are refused, including the multi-fault case at G05 before its G09 fault and the actual unresolved RC59 planning input at G02. The only pass is explicitly synthetic and grants zero physical authorizations.
affectedProblemsIfValidated: A validated physical transfer would supply a common admission layer for an untouched RUL cohort, twin updates, accelerated-life extrapolation, and autonomous experiment queues without erasing their distinct downstream metrics.
surfaceSimilarityRisk: All four fields use workflows and measurements, but that resemblance is insufficient. The connection is valid only where the same pre-outcome type-refuse-capability structure can be instantiated with problem-specific variables and independent adjudication.
